authorization: User authorized autonomous diagnosis, evidence-based next steps and execution until honest Phase 1 development and independent confirmation pass.
goal: Historical visual evidence improves future prediction under all original Phase 1 gates; no promise of empirical success.
checkpoint_selection: earliest minimum of equal-weight four-condition by two-horizon validation normalized MSE

gate_diagnostic.replacement: same-checkpoint recent prediction plus/minus half-difference of frozen history sibling predictions
gate_diagnostic.missing_pair_covariance: INCOMPLETE; do not manufacture a CI

gate_conditional_candidate.requires: reference recent-replacement diagnostic SUPPORTED with all prespecified difficult slices and ID check reported
gate_conditional_candidate.only_change: add pair-common anchor loss with current-parameter detached recent teacher

motion_candidate: Not selected before actual frozen 2x2 diagnosis; a subsequent single-factor plan must be written and hashed before training.
adoption: candidate privileged vs fixed matched-reference recent original gain rules in every test slice and seed
critical privileged absolute MSE improvement vs matched reference, each seed and pooled
all original information and provenance boundaries
scope_exclusions: changing GO thresholds or discarding seeds
passing off revealed development as confirmation
execution: One allocated course CPU science job at a time. Original v3 and initial v4 diagnostics checkout remain frozen. New version is isolated; no overwrite during active job. No GPU/reencoding for this development.
